preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100,000.
The length of the permutations n must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i] <= n for i in range(n)) and all(1 <= b[i] <= n for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: All elements in permutations a and b must be distinct integers from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(d[i] in {0, a[i], b[i]} for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each element in d must be either 0, a[i], or b[i].
The total sum of n across all test cases must not exceed 500,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of valid permutations c modulo 10^9+7.
